好的陪伴，是讓你越來越不需要它 →: Good support makes you need it less and less →
很多課程、很多老師，一開始說要帶你找回自己，最後卻變成你離不開他。: Many courses and teachers promise to help you find yourself, and end up making you unable to leave them.
真正好的陪伴，應該讓你越來越清醒、越來越自由，最後越來越不需要它。: Truly good support should leave you clearer and freer, and in the end, needing it less and less.
這也是我們做頻率文明的原則：有一天你會畢業，回到你自己。: That's the principle behind Frequency Civilization too: one day you graduate, and come back to yourself.
看看你現在依賴的課程、關係或工具：它讓你更有力量，還是更離不開它？: Look at a course, relationship or tool you rely on right now. Does it make you stronger, or harder to leave?
